business_problem: MongoDB needed to stop sales reps from spending 4 to 6 hours per account or deal cycle manually stitching together customer context from Salesforce, email, meeting transcripts, and documents before they could plan outreach or prepare for meetings.
solution_summary: MongoDB built Holly, an internal AI workspace, on Atlas Agent Engine so go-to-market teams could work from one governed system of action instead of hopping across disconnected sales tools. Atlas Agent Engine supplies the production runtime, memory, security, identity, orchestration, state, observability, and lifecycle controls for Holly's agents. Holly connects business systems including Salesforce, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Zoom, and Salesloft, then uses that context to generate account and opportunity briefs, highlight unanswered discovery questions, capture insights from meeting transcripts, and update CRM records after conversations. Rather than treating prompts as generic research requests, the workspace grounds each task in MongoDB-specific sales methodology and account context, turning fragmented prep and follow-up work into a single agent-driven workflow.

solution_components.name: Atlas Agent Engine
solution_components.role: Runs Holly's production agents and provides the runtime, memory, identity, security, orchestration, state, observability, and lifecycle controls behind the workspace.

data_flow: Customer and account context from Salesforce, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Zoom, and Salesloft is brought into Holly through Atlas Agent Engine, where agents synthesize the information into meeting briefs, discovery prompts, research outputs, and CRM updates for MongoDB's sales teams.
business_outcome: MongoDB cut outbound prospecting research time by about 95%, reduced meeting and outreach preparation from hours to minutes, and created a single agentic interface that is rolling out across sales, account development, commercial growth, and solutions architecture teams.
metrics: MongoDB account executives spent an average of 4 to 6 hours on administrative work, per account/deal cycle.
Reps who have used Holly have seen an approximate 95% reduction in the time it takes to research and generate outbound prospecting lists.
